edges.why: Decision step 2: the collection is the global MISR Level 1B2 Ellipsoid (MI1B2E) product cut to the GoMACCS blocks 64–72 (same path/orbit/camera/version in the file names; all source files are in the parent); PARENT.

Decision step 2: the collection is the global MISR Level 1B2 Terrain (MI1B2T) product cut to the GoMACCS blocks 64–72 (same path/orbit/camera/version in the file names; all source files are in the parent); PARENT.

Decision step 2: the collection is the global MISR Geometric Parameters (MIB2GEOP) product cut to the GoMACCS blocks 64–72 (same path/orbit/camera/version in the file names; all source files are in the parent); PARENT.

Decision step 2: the collection is the global MISR Level 2 Aerosol (MIL2ASAE) product cut to the GoMACCS blocks 64–72 (same path/orbit/camera/version in the file names; all source files are in the parent); PARENT. The subset holds two production versions (F09_0019 for the first three orbits, F10_0020 after), both present in the parent.

Decision step 2: the collection is the global MISR Level 2 Land Surface (MIL2ASLS) product cut to the GoMACCS blocks 64–72 (same path/orbit/camera/version in the file names; all source files are in the parent); PARENT. The subset holds two production versions (F06_0019 for the first three orbits, F06_0020 after), both present in the parent.

Decision step 2: the collection is the global MISR Level 2 TOA/Cloud Stereo (MIL2TCST) product cut to the GoMACCS blocks 64–72 (same path/orbit/camera/version in the file names; all source files are in the parent); PARENT. The subset holds two production versions (F08_0015 for the first three orbits, F08_0016 after), both present in the parent.
Decision step 4: the Ellipsoid and Terrain radiances are written by the same L1B2 PGE (PGE22) and share one version string (F03_0024).
Decision step 4: the aerosol and land surface products are written by the same Level 2 aerosol/surface PGE (versions 0019 → 0020 together).

suite: Every record copies the global product's INPUT associations instead of recording PARENT → its global product; several copied EntryIds (MIANTOAC, MIANSMT, MIANLDBM, MICNFG, MIANAZM, MIANCSSC, MI1B2EP, MI1B2TP, MIB2CORR, MISANCGM) are not CMR collections; the others give versions without leading zeros (e.g. MIANCARP "2" for CMR "002") or versions CMR does not hold (e.g. MI1B2T "2"), so none resolves.
No document describes how the GoMACCS subsets were made; their provenance is visible only in the abstracts and file names.
The three Level 2 subsets each mix two production versions within one collection version.
3 linked pages return an HTTP error; 0 could not be reached from this environment.

GOMI2AE|002: 12 existing INPUT associations copy the inputs of the global product (e.g. MIB2GEOP, MI1B2T, MI1B2E, MIRCCM, …); by rule 1c-1 they are not inputs of the subset, whose only parent is MIL2ASAE.
3 associations give a version that CMR does not hold for that ShortName: MI1B2T '2' (CMR: ['003', '004']), MI1B2E '2' (CMR: ['003', '004']), MIRCCM '3' (CMR: ['004']).

5 associations write the Version without the leading zeros CMR uses, so they do not resolve: MIB2GEOP '2' (CMR: ['002', '003']), MIANCARP '2' (CMR: ['002']), MIANCAGP '1' (CMR: ['001']), MIANACP '1' (CMR: ['001']), MIANTASC '2' (CMR: ['002']).
